attacks.name: Sonic Blast
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Push|: After each attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Wrath of the Midnight King
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Throw the defender |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Increase the Volume
superPowers.body: During the next attack action made by this character this Turn, add 2 dice to the attack rolls.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes an attack action immediately followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Telepathic Command
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 4. That character Advances |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Inhuman
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.

superPowers.name: Anti-Graviton Control
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage|, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1. Additionally, during the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Inhuman King
superPowers.body: At the start of the |*Activation Phase|, you may choose 1 allied character with the |*Inhuman| |!innate| superpower. The chosen character removes 1 special condition.
